༄༅/ /ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan pa bla rabs dang bcas pa chos 'byung gsal bar ston pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan pa bla rabs dang bcas pa

chos 'byung gsal bar ston pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༈ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rab 'byams rgyal kun ye shes phung po ni/ /rab mdzes gur gum mdog can gzhon nu'i sku/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i ljongs su mngon byon pa/ /rab mchog bla ma rgyal ba gnyis par 'dud/ /mgon de'i bstan pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtse'i bar/ /khyab pa'i grags dkar bdag blo'i yul 'gong yang*/ /dbus gtsang phyogs su ji ltar dar ba'i tshul/ /mkhas pa'i srol zhugs mdor bsdus brjod par bya/ /༈ de la 'dir rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul rje rin po che'i bstan pa shar nub kyi rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar khyab par gyur pa'i tshul rgyas par ni/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang*/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dga' ldan chos 'byung sogs las bshad pa ltar yin la/ 'dir rang gi skal bar bsams te rje'i bstan pa ser 'bras dge gsum sogs su dar ba'i tshul tsam zhig bshad par bya ste/ rje rin po che 'di nyid lung bstan pa'i gzhung du ma zhig snang ba rnams drangs na mang du 'gyur dogs te/ ming tsam gyi sgo nas brjod na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ mdo sde rgyan gyi bshad pa'i le'u/ rgyal po bka' 'bum/ rgyal po bka' thang*/ pad+ma bka' chems/ rat+na'i spyi lung chen po/ mtsho sna zangs brag gi gter lung*/ bka' gdams glegs bam gyi skor nas kyang rje rin po che 'di nyid 'byon par lung bstan cing*/ dpal ldan zla bas kyang lung bstan to/ /rje 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ mdo smad btsong kha'i yul du yab klu 'bum dge dang*/ yum shing bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i me bya la sku bltams/ dgung lo gsum pa'i tshe dge bsnyen dang*/ bdun pa'i dus su rab byung mdzad de blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bcu drug bar du mkhan po la bsten nas mdo sngags kyi skor mang du gsan/

dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i dus su chos rje don grub rin chen la bsten nas dbus su phebs/ de nas bde ba can dang sa skya sogs su phebs nas phar tshad sogs gzhung chen rnams la sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur nas dbus dang gtsang gi chos grwa rnams su dka' bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad pa na zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ bla ma rje btsun red mda' ba/ chos kyi dpal ba/ khyung po lhas pa/ lho brag phyag rdor sogs bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos kun la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad cing*/ khyad par du bla ma dbu ma pas lo ts+tsha mdzad de rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos rnams la dogs gcod mang du mdzad la/ phyis dga' ba gdong du 'jam dbyang kyi zhal gzigs te de nas bzung rje btsun nyid las lta ba'i dri rtog dang 'dus pa sogs kyi chos tshul mtha' yas pa dngos su gsan no/ /rjes chos gsan pa'i bla ma mang du yod kyang gtso bo ni chos rje don yod rin chen/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ bla ma dbu ma pa/ lho brag grub chen dang bzhi'o/ /de dag kyang mi'i bla ma'i dbang du byas shing rten 'brel bstod pa las/ bla ma'i drin gyi mthong ba'i tshe/ /zhes pa ltar na bla ma thams cad kyi gtso bo ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs so/ /gzhan yang mdo sngags kyi lam rim gnyis la sogs pa rtsom pa mdzad pa dang*/ gdul bya la chos ji ltar bstan pa dang*/ dben pa bsten nas nyams len mdzad pa dang*/ nyams su blangs nas rgyud la rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa ji ltar 'khrungs pa rnams 'god par mi lang bas gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir ni dga' ldan/ 'bras spungs/ se ra/ bkra shis lhun po sogs su dgon pa 'debs pa'i dus dang*/ de dag tu rje'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bla rabs ji ltar byung ba'i tshul cung zad bshad pa la/ thog mar dga' ldan ni/ rje dgung lo nga gsum pa'i thog lha sa'i smon lam chen mo grol nas/ gsang bdag gis lung bstan pa ltar 'grog ring zhabs kyi bcag cing*/

rgyal tshab dang 'dul 'dzin gnyis kyis khur bzhes nas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab ste dge 'dun gyi sde rim kyis tshugs/ dgung lo nga dgu'i gong dpon nam mkha' bzang po dang*/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje la bkas bskul te 'bras spungs gzhi bting nas dgung lo nga dgu'i thog tu grub/ dgung lo re gsum thog byams chen chos rje la bka' gnang ste se ra theg chen gling btab/ re gsum pa sa phag lo de'i zla ba bcu pa yan la sku dngos kyi gdul bya smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i mdzad pa kun mthar phyin te/ zla ba bcu pa'i nyer lnga la gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su nye bar bsdus nas dga' ldan du gshegs/ rje la bu slob nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mang yang sras kyi thu bo ni rje bzhugs pa'i skabs der grags pa rgyal tshab rje dang 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis/ mkhas grub rje ni thugs sras kyi gtso bo/ /rje sku gzhon pa'i dus kyi bu slob sngar tshar ba grags che ba rnam pa bzhi ste/ tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa/ grags pa blo gros/ dzñā na shrī/ dge bshes ston pa'o/ /phyi tshar 'jam dkar ba/ bzang skyong ba/ rin rgyal ba/ byang seng ba/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ shes rab grags pa/ 'jam dpal bkra shis/ dpal skyong pa ste 'khor dag pa rnam pa brgyad/ 'phrin las rgya che ba/ rje dge 'dun grub/ bkra shis dpal ldan/ rgyal mtshan bzang po/ rje btsun shes rab seṅge ste lnga'o/ /bstan pa'i sgron me lta bu ni/ dkon mchog tshul khrims/ rgyal dbang kha che/ rin bsam pa/ grags bzang ba/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal/ blo gros chos skyong*/ ba so chos rgyan/ dpal seng ba/ snar thang ba dang bcu'o/ /gzhan don nus pa'i byang sems ni/ shākya bsod nams/ kun dga' bzang po/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog grags bzang ba ste drug go /ti shrir bkur ba byams chen chos rje dang byang dar ba gnyis so/

/dpon sras nam mkha' dpal dang bsod nams rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan pa bkra shis rgya tsho dang legs pa rgyal mtshan gnyis/ rnam dpyod phul du byung ba rin chen seṅge dang chos dbang grags pa gnyis/ bstan pa spel nus pa stod smad sher bzang gnyis dang*/ ngag dbang grags pa/ rgyal mtshan seṅge/ dpal ldan shes rab/ yon tan dpal zhes pa ste drug skad gnyis smra ba gzhon nu dpal ba dang stag lung ba gnyis/ sde bdag dpal ldan bzang po/ /bsod nams bzang po/ byang chub rdo rje/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ don grub rgyal po/ bkra shis dpal 'od de drug go /mang du mkhyen pa chos rje sher 'byung*/ rin bsam pa/ grags pa rin chen/ bsod nams rin chen/ rin chen rgyal ba/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rin chen grags pa/ bde 'byang dang brgyad do/ /mdo rong gi mkhas pa mdo smad 'od zer/ legs bzang*/ bsod nams shes rab/ lce nag pa dang bzhi'o/ /grub pa'i gdung byang dpal ba dang rin chen dpal gnyis/ ya mtshan can gyi skyes bu smon lam dpal ba dang bsod nams rin chen gnyis/ spyan snga ni kun blo/ gzhon nu 'od/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dpal bzang pa/ nam rgyal ba/ bsod nams lhun grub/ rin rgyal ba/ rin chen 'phel dang brgyad do/ /khri chen ni chos rje mdzes pa dpal/ bla chen nyan shag pa/ gu shrī dpal ldan don grub/ chos rje ye shes dpal dang bzhi'o/ /mkhan chen ni chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ rgyal bzang ba/ kun rdor ba/ byang dpal ba ste bzhi'o/ /chen po ni grags bzang ba/ dgas po/ blo 'phel/ kun rgyal/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang lnga'o/ /chos bsgo ba 'jam dbyangs kha che dang bkra shis rin chen gnyis/ dka' bcu pa ni dar bzang*/ 'kha' ser/ rgyal mtshan/ hu la ba dang bzhi'o/ /bka' bzhi pa/ don yod/ rin chen dpal/ rin chen chos rgyal/ sangs rgyas dbang phyug sangs rgyas bzang po/ bsod nams bzang po/ gro sa ba/ 'chor bu ba/ chos seng*/ grags pa rgyal mtshan dang bcu'o/

/jo stan pa ni zla ba blo gros/ bsod nams lhun grub/ legs rin pa/ kong po dang bzhi'o/ /gnas brtan ni legs bzang ba/ /don grub dpal/ dge 'dun rgyal po/ 'od zer bkra shis/ gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ kun dga' 'bum dang drug go /rtogs ldan ni sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sho re/ grags pa 'byung gnas/ ral zhig pa/ nam mkha' rgyal ba dang lnga'o/ /gzhan yang grags pa rgya mtsho/ gzhon nu dpal ba/ bsam rgyal ba/ gser thub pa/ yang steng rin po che/ zhi blo dbon po/ drung nam mkha'/ mgon po byang chub/ bsod nams rin chen/ drung chos 'phags pa/ shāg rin pa/ zla ba bzang po/ chos rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas ye shes sogs shin tu mang yang de'i nang nas brgya dang bzhi bcus ni so so nas chos sde re btab cing bstan bcos mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas rje'i bstan pa la bya ba lhag par byas so/ /gdan sa'i gtso bo dga' ldan gyi khri rabs ni/ thog ma rje rang nyid dang*/ khri thog gnyis pa rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen ni gtsang stod du 'khrungs shing*/ gzhung lugs thams cad la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ rje zhing du gshegs khar dbu zhwa gnang ste don gyis khrir bsko bar mdzad cing*/ rje gshegs rjes dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag lor 'dul 'dzin pa sogs dge 'dun pa rnams kyis khri thog tu mnga' gsol/ phar tshad kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing*/ dgung lo re dgu pa chu khyir dag zhing du gshegs so/ /khri thog gsum pa mkhas grub dge legs dpa' bzang ni gtsang stod du rab byung bdun pa'i shing glang lor 'khrungs/ mkhas grub lha dbang blo'i sku skyer ngos bzung ba la brten nas mkhas grub chos rjer grags/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung kun la zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ dgung lo zhe bdun pa lcags phag la khri thog tu phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi pa sa rta lor dag zhing du gshegs so/

༈ /khri thog bzhi pa zha lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan ni gtsang du shing yos la 'khrungs/ dgung lo re bzhi pa sa rta la khri thog tu phebs/ 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor la mkhas shing mthu nus che bas log par 'khu ba 'ga' zhig tshar bcad/ dgung lo don drug pa lcags rta la zhi bar gshegs so/ /khri thog lnga pa chos rje blo gros chos skyong ni g.yag sder sa sbrul la 'khrungs/ mkhas grub rin po che brten nas mdo sngags kun dang dus 'khor la mkhas par sbyangs/ dgung lo re gnyis pa rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags rta la khrir phebs/ bstan bcos kyang 'ga' re rtsom zhing don lnga ba chu lug la zhi bar gshegs so/ /༈ khri thog drug pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni mkhas grub rje'i gcung por chu rta la 'khrungs/ rje dang mkhas grub la brten nas mdo sngags kun dang 'dus pa la sbyangs pas mkhas shing grub pa brnyes/ dgung lo re gnyis pa chu lug la khrir phebs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel/ don gnyis pa chu sbrul la dag zhing du gshegs so/ /khri thog bdun pa blo gros brtan pa ni gtsang phyogs su chu rtar 'khrungs/ rje dang rgyal tshab pa brten nas gzhung lugs kun la mkhas par sbyangs shing bstan bcos kyang brtsams/ dgung lo don gnyis pa chu sbrul la khrir phebs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ don bdun pa sa khyi la zhi bar gshegs so/ /khri thog brgyad pa smon lam dpal ba ni g.yas ru byang du shing rtar 'khrungs/ dge 'dun grub pa sogs brten nas gzhung chen kun la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ phar tshad rnams la mkhas shing bstan bcos kyang kha shas mdzad/ dgung lo re bdun pa lcags byi la khrir phebs te chos mang du gsungs nas/ don brgyad pa lcags phag la dag zhing du gshegs so/ /rje gshegs nas 'di'i bar lo don gsum song snang*/ rgyal tshab nas 'di'i bar 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud ces grags te sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul du nges so/

/'di man chad mtshan sgra tsam gyi sgo nas brjod na/ khri thog dgu pa rje blo bzang nyi ma/ bcu pa chos rje ye shes bzang po/ bcu gcig pa 'dar ston blo bzang grags/ bcu gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu gsum pa chos kyi bshes gnyen/ bcu bzhi pa rin chen 'od zer/ bcwo lnga pa paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ bcu drug pa chos skyong rgya mtsho/ bcu bdun pa rdo rje bzang po/ bcwo brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bcu dgu pa ngag dbang chos grags/ nyi shu pa chos grags bzang po/ nyer gcig pa dge legs dpal bzang*/ nyer gnyis pa dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas/ nyer gsum pa tshe brtan rgya mtsho/ nyer bzhi ba byams pa rgya mtsho/ nyer lnga pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ nyer drug pa dam chos dpal 'bar/ nyer bdun pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ nyer brgyad pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ nyer dgu pa bshes gnyen grags pa/ sum cu pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ so gcig pa dam chos dpal ba/ so gnyis pa tshul khrims chos 'phel/ so gsum pa grags pa rgya mtsho/ so bzhi pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ so lnga pa dgon mchog chos 'phel/ so drug pa bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ so bdun pa dge 'dun rin chen/ so brgyad pa bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ so dgu pa dkon mchog chos bzang*/ bzhi cu pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ zhe gcig pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ zhe gnyis pa blo bzang don yod/ zhe gsum pa byams pa bkra shis/ zhe bzhi pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ zhe lnga pa tshul khrims dar rgyas/ zhe drug pa sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ zhe bdun pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ zhe brgyad pa slar yang tshul khrims dar rgyas te de yan ni baiḍūr+ya ser por gsal la/ ༈de nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mjug gi cha shing byi 'di'i bar lo lnga bcur nye bar song 'dug pas lo bdun re'i dbang du byas na de'i bar khri thog bdun gyi skor song bar nges so/ /de ltar na bdun po gong gi zhe brgyad kyi steng bsnan pas khri thog nga lnga'i skor song bar snang ngo*/

/khri thog pa de thams cad kyis kyang rje'i bstan pa lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bzung ste spel bar mdzad pa rgyas par so so'i rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ /dgal ldan du byang rtse dang shar rtse gnyis byung ba'i byang rtse'i bla rabs kyi thog ma ni/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ de nas kun dga' bkra shis/ blo gros brtan pa/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ shes rab bzang po/ tshul khrims bzang po/ shes rab dang*/ rgyal mtshan bzang po/ /chos grags bzang po/ dge 'dun bstan dar/ byams pa rgya mtsho/ dam chos dpal 'bar/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis 'byung gnas/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos grags/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang chos rgyan/ bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal bkra shis/ dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ dam chos rnam rgyal/ blo bzang don yod/ ngag dbang nor bu/ byams pa rin chen/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang phun tshogs/ don grub rgya mtsho sogs so/ ༈ /shar rtser ni rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zla grags/ nyi grags/ rgyal mtshan/ smon lam dpal/ ye shes bzang po/ mdar ston blo bzang*/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ bzang po/ bsod nams grags pa/ dkon mchog dar/ rdo rje bzang po/ ngag dbang chos grags/ dge legs dpal bzang*/ tshe brtan rgya mtsho/ shākya rin chen/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' rgyan mtshan/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ don grub seṅge/ bshes gnyen grags pa/ nyi ma bzang po/ dam chos dpal/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog chos 'phel ba/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dge 'dun rin chen/ ngag dbang rin chen/ dkon mchog bzang*/ blo bzang rnam rgyal/ blo bzang dpal 'bar/ byams pa bkra shis/ dge 'dun grags pa/ tshul khrims dar rgyas/ blo bzang chos 'phel sogs so/ /dga' ldan sogs su rgyud pa grwa tshang dang bla rabs byung tshul ni/ rjes rje btsun shes rab seṅge la 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad srol 'dzin pa'i bka' babs pas thog ma ni bla ma de nyid yin la/

de nyid kyis gtsang phyogs nas rgyud kyi 'chad nyan mdzad cing*/ srad rin chen rtse bas sbyin bdag mdzad nas rgyud grwa btsugs pa la srad rgyud par grags/ de nas srad rgyud kyi bla rabs ni/ 'dul nag dpal ldan bzang po/ rog tsho chos mdzad/ dge 'dun 'phel/ chos dbyings/ bkra shis 'phags/ bsam grub rgya mtsho/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ brtson 'grus 'phags/ rdo rje bzang po/ byams pa rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun rgyal po/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ chos dbang*/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ phug chen pa/ shes rab rin chen/ dpal ldan mchog sbyin/ mchog legs 'od zer/ dkon mchog yar 'phel/ blo bzang ye shes/ blo bzang don grub sogs so/ /rje btsun shes rab seṅges thog mar stod gtsang du rgyud grwa btsugs nas dbus su phebs te rgyud kyi 'chad nyan btsugs nas phyogs phyogs su chos bar bteg cing*/ rab byung bdun pa'i thog rgyud grwa tshugs pa la rgyud smad du grags shing*/ de'i bla rabs ni/ rdo rje 'chang sbyin pa dpal/ kun dga' don grub/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ shes rab bzang po/ u ri dka' bcu pa/ slob dpon tshul bzang*/ chos skyong rgya mtsho/ rgyal mtshan bzang po/ chos grags bzang po/ nam mkha' grags/ byams pa rgya mtsho/ bkra shis bzang po/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ rnam rgyal dpal bzang*/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang chos rgyan/ bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ chos rgyal bkra shis/ dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ dam chos rnam rgyal/ blo bzang don yod/ blo bzang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang nor bu/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ don grub rgya mtsho sogs so/ /rgyud stod bla rabs ni/ rje btsun shes rab seṅge'i dngos slob rgyud pa kun dga' don grub kyis dbus stod du rgyud kyi 'chad nyan gnang bas rgyud stod par grags/ de nas lha dbang rin chen/ chos ldan blo gros/

bsod nams grags pa/ dkon mchog dar/ ngag dbang chos grags/ dge legs dpal/ tshe brtan rgya mtsho/ shākya rin chen/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ byang chub 'od zer/ 'jam dbyangs 'od zer/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog chos 'phel/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang chos 'phel/ dkon mchog bzang*/ byams pa rnam rgyal/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang dpal 'bar/ byams pa bkra shis/ dge 'dun grags pa/ blo bzang dge legs/ blo bzang chos 'phel gnyis la sogs pa ste phyis dbus phyogs su spos so/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi bla rabs ni/ gong du brjod pa ltar rje'i sras 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan de nyid kyis rje'i bka' ltar rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel lor 'bras spungs btab ste mdo sngags gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing sgo mang blo gsal gling bde yangs sogs grwa tshang bdun btsugs/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes par grags shing 'phrin las rnam mkha' dang mnyam pa de nyid kyi gdan sa'i thog ma mdzad de/ gdan sa gnyis pa dpal ldan seṅge/ gsum pa rin chen byang chub/ blo bzang nyi ma/ blo bzang grags/ shākya rin chen/ smon lam dpal/ legs pa chos 'byor/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bsod nams grags pa/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ blo bzang chos kyi rgya mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtsho/ blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'o/ /sgo mang grwa tshang du bla rabs ni/ dang por grags pa rin chen/ rga leb/ tshul bzang*/ dpal she/ kun rgyal ba/ dbang dpal ba/ dpal blo dang shes blo/ ye shes grags/ dpal ldan 'od zer dang dkon mchog bzang*/ rin chen byang chub/ ngag dbang 'byung gnas/ blo bzang e baṃ/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ byams pa lhun grub/ brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ dge legs lhun grub/

chos grags rnam rgyal/ sangs rgya bkra shis/ dge legs dpal 'byor/ blo bzang ngag dbang*/ ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ 'phrin las lhun grub/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ don grub rgya mtsho gnyis/ 'od zer sogs so/ /blo gsal gling du thog ma legs ldan pa/ de nas gzhu bsod pa/ dpal ldan blo gros/ tshul blo/ ye shes bzang po/ tre bo pa/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/ sangs rgyas bzang po/ rin chen dar ma dang sangs legs/ yon tan 'od/ bsod nams grags pa/ dge 'dun don grub/ bkra shis 'od zer/ bsam gtan mchog gtsang pa bkra shis/ chos grags 'od zer sogs so/ /bde yang su dang por byang dpal/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ dbang rgyal/ brtson 'grus/ blo seng*/ nam mkha' ba/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rin dar ba/ rgyal mtshan legs pa/ rin chen rnam rgyal sogs so/ /'dul ba grwa tshang du dang por brtson 'grus grags pa/ dge legs dpal/ dpal ldan blo gros/ gro sa ba/ dpal 'byor ba/ rin chen grags sogs so/ /shag skor grwa tshang du snar thang ba/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rin chen blo gros/ dbu se/ bde blo/ chos bshes/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs so/ /thos bsam gling du kun bzang rin chen/ shākya rin chen/ rgyal bzang ba/ dpal ldan pa/ dpal rgyal mtshan/ bsam gtan shes rab/ blo gros mtha' yas sogs so/ /sngags pa grwa tshangs du rgyal mtshan tshul khrims/ sbyin mchog pa/ rin chen mchog mgon po rgyal mtshan/ gdengs ka ba/ thog kha ba/ dpal thung ba/ nam mkha' bzang po sogs so/ /chos 'khor gling du don grub mgon po/ ldan chung ba/ drung chen pa/ sangs rgyas bkra shis/ ngag dbang chos 'phel/ bstan 'dzin 'phrin las sogs byon no/ /'di rnams ni 'bras spungs pa'i skor te/ de rnams kyi nang nas grwa tshang grags che ba ni sgo mang dang*/ blo gsal gling gnyis so/ /grwa pa spyi'i grangs ni stong phrag bzhi lhag tsam ste/ lung bstan ltar na lnga stong tshogs pa'ang 'byung ngo*/ /se ra theg chen gling gi bla brgyud ni/

dgon 'di byams chen chos rje btab pa ste/ de yang rje rin po che rgya nag tu spyan 'dren par btang ba'i tshab tu khong rgya nag tu byon/ slar byon nas rje dang mjal nas 'bul chen mdzad/ rje zhing du gshegs pa'i sa phag lo der rje nyid kyi bka' ltar se ra theg chen gling gsar du btab ste rten mang du bzhengs/ rnam thos sras 'grub pas sku bsod shin tu che/ stod smad rgya 'brong steng ste grwa tshang bzhi btsugs/ gdan sa thog mar dar rgyas bzang po/ shākya tshul khrims/ de nas gu ru rgya mtshan bzang po ste 'di ni rje'i bu slob rnams kyi nang nas mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa zhig go /bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rin chen blo gros/ chos rje 'dul 'dzin pa/ lha phug chos rje/ dpal 'byor lhun grub/ dpal ldan blo gros/ don yod dpal ldan/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje btsun pa/ bsod nams grags pa/ chos grags bzang po/ rje bsod nams/ rgya mtsho/ stong 'khor ba/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ tshang dbyangs rgya mtsho/ bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i bar ro/ /sngar grwa tshang bzhi byung ba'i rgya 'braung gnyis stong pa grwa tshang du bsdus nas de'i bla ma shes rab rgya mtsho/ chos blo/ shākya bzang po/ blo gros rin chen/ 'jam grags pa/ mañdzu pa/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rin chen dar ma/ chos rje don grub/ dar gling pa/ bstan pa dar rgyas/ blo bzang e waṃ/ rin chen gnyis/ yon tan 'od zer sogs so/ /'on kyang phyis stod pa yang smad grwa tshang du bsdus so/ /se ra smad grwa tshang ni dang po byang chub 'bum pa pas btab cing*/ de nas brtson 'grus bzang po/ shākya bkra shis/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mtshe ma dbang rgyal/ tshul rgyas bzang po/ zla 'od dpal mgon/ yon tan bshes gnyen/ tshul khrims 'od zer/ chos grags rin chen/ rdo rje bzang po/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshul khrims 'od zer/ chos bzang grags pa/

la mo ba/ dge legs bzang po/ byang chub 'od zer/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ bkra shis 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang chos rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas dpal 'byor/ dge 'dun rin chen/ bzang po rnam rgyal/ shes rab seṅge/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ byams pa lhun grub/ blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin legs bshad/ spom spor ba rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang dpal 'bar/ dge 'dun 'jam dbyangs/ tshul khrims dar rgyas/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang don grub/ slob dpon tshul khrims dar rgyas sogs te 'di'i skabs su kho bo cag smad grwa tshang du slob gnyer byed do/ /de nas da lta'i bar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mjug gi shing bya 'di'i bar du lo bzhi bcu'i skor song 'dug pas bla rabs kyang mang du byung ste 'brir ma lang ngo*/ /se ra byes grwa tshang ni/ thog mar gdan sa ngag dbang dang dzñā na shrīs 'chad nyan cung zad mdzad kyang bar skabs su stong*/ de rjes sne'u dpal 'byor rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis kyis slar btsugs kyang gzhi ma chags pa'i dbang gis phyogs phyogs su 'byon pa'i chos bar 'debs dgos pa zhig byung bas ming yang byes su grags/ slob dpon thog ma ni gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ dpal ldan blo gros/ don yod dpal ldan/ rje btsun pa/ shes rab seṅge/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan/ bde legs nyi ma/ mkhas btsun rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rin chen bshes gnyen/ bsod nams lhun grub/ 'phrin las lhun grub/ dpal 'byor lhun grub/ bsam 'grub rin chen/ byams pa smon lam/ 'phrin las bsam grub/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs lhun grub/ blo bzang bkra shis/ rgyal mtshan don grub/ ngag dbang rgya mtsho sogs so/ /se ra'i grwa pa spyi'i grangs ni nyis stong brgyad brgya'i skor dang*/ sum stong tshogs pa'i skabs kyang yod do/ /da lta ni or sgos grwa tshang zhes pa zhig kyang yod par grags so/

/smad grwa tshang du mkhas grub bstan dar ba'i dbu phar gyi spyi don thal phreng*/ blo gros legs bzang ba'i 'dul ba/ dngos grub pa'i mdzod rnams chad nyan mdzad la/ ser byes su ni bde legs nyi ma'i 'dul ba/ rje btsun pa'i phar phyin thal phreng*/ se ra shar ba dang dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi phar phyin ṭik+ka /dngos grub pa'i mdzod/ rje btsun pa dang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa'i dbu ma sogs la 'chad nyan mdzad do/ /grwa tshang 'di gnyis na dngos su lnga pa chen po'i mdzod la 'chad nyan med kyang blo 'dzin byed mkhan ni mang du snang ngo*/ /gzhan yang dbus phyogs su grwa tshang che phra nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mang bas rgyas par ni su zhig gis brjod par nus/ 'on kyang ming tsam gyis 'ga' zhig brjod na/ lha sa na rme ru bzhi sde gnyis dang*/ gzhan na gsang sngags mkhar/ gsang phu bar/ rab stod pa sogs dga' ldan pa'i grwa tshang bzhi dang*/ sa skya pa'i grwa tshang bdun te bcu gcig yod par bshad/ der byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis drang nges la rtsod pa'i rten 'brel gyis gling stod smad gnyis/ sa dga' ldan gnyis/ ra ba stod smad gnyis kyang byung ste de dag gi bla rabs yod cing*/ ra ba stod pa'i bla rabs kyi thog ma ni paṇa chen mchog lha 'od zer ro/ /ra ba stod pa ni thog ma gsang phun yod kyang phyis nye thang bde ba can du tshogs pa'o/ /gsang phu ni jo bo rjes lung bstan pa ltar rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis btab ste bstan pa'i 'byung gnas zhig go /gdan sa ba ni zhang tshe spong*/ gnyal sa/ rnam 'phar sa/ cha ba chos seng sogs so/ /gzha yang*/ tshal gung thang*/ yang dgon/ dbus gling*/ chos khri lho lcog /chos 'khor gling*/ yer pa spos dga'/ grog mkhar/ glang ra/ bkra shis ljongs/ cha phu brag sogalhas bu dgon/ lhas glang lung*/ lhas brag ba lam nub rdzong*/ ba lam chos 'khor/ skam dkon/ skyor mo lung*/ de'i cha shas khyams sa/ yug khang pa 'di la sngags grwa dang mtshan nyid grwa tshang gnyis/

dga' ba gdong*/ stod lung chu bzang*/ lam sa/ rde'u ri/ sdings ka ra tshag ste stod lung pa'o/ /mtsho smad/ shun mar khu sbus kyu/ tsher gsel dgon/ spang bu dgon/ bkra shis chos sdings/ nyan chu bzang*/ thang bu dgon no/ /yang skyid smad du gsang sngags pho brang*/ skyid stod kyi ge re dgon/ snon gyi dum bu ri/ la mo tsher gseb/ dge 'dun sgang*/ btsun mo tshal/ nye sdings/ bde mo thang*/ mas dro cha dkar/ kang kang dgon/ brag rgyas/ thang skya/ e waṃ chos sde/ phag mo chos sde/ phag mo lo dgon/ rgyu dgon/ spo tho/ dben dgon/ ser dgon/ skyid spro dgon/ shugs gseb/ khri ltag ra khyim/ gur sngon/ zhogs phud 'od gsal/ 'phan yul rin chen grags/ dgon nang*/ 'brong steng*/ pu to dgon/ rgyal lha khang*/ gsal khang dgon/ nyan so dgon/ 'bri khung dgon/ rwa sgreng*/ de'i yang dgon/ de'i bsam gtan gling*/ shags mkhar dgon/ ri chos dgon/ bsam rtse sgrub sde/ 'ba' tsha chos sde/ dpal 'bar sgang*/ spyil bu ba/ dbye bo dgon/ mnga' phu dgon/ byams pa gling*/ lha rtse dgon/ 'od snang dgon/ zhwa lha khang*/ bya yul mang ta/ stag phug chos sde/ snyug rum/ chos 'khor sgang*/ mkhar skya/ rgyal bzang*/ rin chen gling*/ ru thog dgon/ 'ol kha/ rdzing phyi dgon/ bsam gtan gling*/ chu bzang*/ chos lung*/ nyi ma gling*/ ri bo gser gling*/ rin chen sgang*/ sleb ri dgon/ mo dge lung*/ chos 'khor rgyal/ dwags po grwa tshang*/ mnga' ris grwa tshang*/ sgar ba grwa tshang*/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang*/ bsam gtan gling*/ bra steng dgon/ dwags po/ lha ding dgon/ mkhar thog lhas steng*/ se lung la kha/ sgrom mda'/ dgyer dgon/ rgya ri dgon/ ri sgo/ klog se bo/ mdo mkhar/ cha dkar/ e rong dga' ldan/ rgyal lha thog steng*/ thar gling ri khrod/ ze mo gdong dgon/ bkra shi chos gling*/ dga' ldan chos gling*/ grwa skor/ zangs po che/ ri sdeng*/ ngang skyal/ te'u ra/ phye kha ste gnyal sde drug

mkhar sde/ pad+ma bkod/ gung thang*/ lho brag 'gro ba dgon/ khyung tshang dgon/ glo bo dgon/ gdang dgon/ bkra shis chos gling*/ 'byar thog dgon/ yug nam steng*/ mtsho sna dgon/ mdo mkhar chos sde/ mon mtsho sna/ chos grwa chen po rtses dang*/ bkra shis bde chen/ thang po che/ chos 'khor sde/ dgon gling*/ rol khang*/ rgyal gsar sgang*/ lhag ru/ dga' ldan gling*/ ri bo chos gling*/ theg chen gling*/ ri bo bde chen/ spyan g.yas/ bsam dgon rtse/ mon mkhar zhugs dgon/ er dge/ lha sdings/ glang lung*/ byams pa gling*/ ri bo rnam rgyal/ khra bde gling*/ dga' ldan chos 'khor sdings/ dga' lung dgon la sogs pa ste/ de dag las btsun ma dgon dang 'ga' zhig ma gtogs rje rin po che'i bstan pas khyab bo/ /rje'i bstan pa gtsang phyogs su dar tshul ni/ rje nyid grwa skor sogs kyi ched du gtsang phyogs su phebs pa'i stobs dang*/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtshos rje'i rig lugs 'dzin pa'i chos sde btab pa thon rgyal byed tshal/ de nas lha ri dgon/ dga' ldan lhun po/ rab rgyas gling*/ kun ra dgon/ ngo ba ri/ dge 'phel/ byams chen chos sde/ bde ba can/ lhan pa so/ dben rtsa/ ri bo dge 'phel/ shangs 'bras spungs/ spor thog ba shel/ yol dkar/ shangs grwa tshang chen mo ste de rnams kyi bla rabs dang*/ khyad par du bkra shis lhun po ni/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis me yos brgyad pa'i thog tu btab nas mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang zhig btsugs par bshad kyang*/ phyis 'chad nyan gyi grwa tshang gsum byung ste/ shar rtse grwa tshang*/ dkyil khar grwa tshang*/ thos bsam gling gi grwa tshang ngo*/ /sngags pa grwa tshang ni paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgya mtshan gyis phyis su btsugs te de dang bcas bkra shis lhun po na grwa tshang bzhi'o/ /de dag so so'i bla rabs rnams ni re zhig bzhag ste/ bkra shis lhun po'i khri thog pa ni/ paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya tsho/

paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ don yod rgya mtsho/ blo gros legs bzang*/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos dpal rgya mtsho/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bsam 'grub dpal bzang*/ dam chos yar 'phel/ lha dbang blo gros/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes so/ /bkra shis lhun po'i dge 'dun kun bsdoms na phyed dang sum stong skor dang*/ de las lhag tshogs pa yang 'byung ngo*/ /dben sa ni mkhas grub rje'i sku skye bsod nams phyogs glang gis btab cing gdan sa pa lha gshongs pa/ skyabs mchog dpal bzang*/ blo bzang don grub/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mchog sbrul blo bzang ye shes so/ /gzhan yang gtsang phyogs na dga' ldan chos 'phel/ 'brong rtse dang*/ dpal 'khor chos sde 'di mkhas grub rjes btab cing grwa tshang bdun te/ rgya rong lha khang*/ nor bu dga' ldan/ legs grub/ gser khang*/ zhi gnas/ grang mo che/ bde 'byor grwa tshang rnams so/ /de dag ni rje bla ma'i lugs srol 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan yang der sa lugs bzhi/ zha lu ba gcig dus 'khor ba bzhi/ sa dge thun mong ba gnyis bcas khyon grwa tshang bcu bdun yod par bshad de/ thams cad kyi thog ma'i spyi bla ni mkhas grub rje'o/ /gnas snying du grwa tshang drug byung ste/ skyed tshal/ mchod kha/ se ra/ zur khang*/ nags zhabs/ gzhis dgon no/ /shab stong lhun rtse/ bsam grub sde chen/ bkra shis dge 'phel/ mkha' spyod/ brag dkar/ gser sdings/ ri khrod dga' ldan/ mngon dga'/ gser gling*/ rin chen sgang*/ bsam sdings/ bsam gling*/ thar ba/ rgod tshang*/ g.yang chos sde/ dar rgyas sgrub sde/ lha sdings/ yang rin chen sgang*/ ri bo mdangs can/ ri mkhar/ gser gling*/ rdo rje gdan/ chos rdzong*/ bzhad steng*/ bzhad grwa/ rta nag la kha/ ri khud/ rta nag sde chen/

lhun grub rtse/ bzhad dga' ldan/ bzhad bres kha/ 'brong phu/ dben sa dge 'phel/ dpal snang thang*/ rgyal chen rtse/ gnas chos sde/ sngon mo rdzong*/ seng rtse/ byang chen/ dpal sdings/ rog tsho/ nam mkha' chos mdzod/ shel dkar chos lung*/ dga' ldan dar rgyas/ dngos grub chos rdzong*/ nor bu sgang*/ zab mo brag go /gzhan yang ngam rim du grags pa'i dgon sder dge lugs kyi grwa tshang bcu ste/ sde gung pa/ bde gling shar ba/ rta shar ba/ bkra shis sgang*/ bsam grub dga' ldan/ mdog bum pa/ chos lung lho pa/ bde ba can pa/ chos lung*/ lung dga' ldan pa'o/ /der sa skya'i grwa tshang bcwo lnga ste/ dkar po legs/ dkar po shar/ mngon dga' shar ba/ ltag rtse ba/ chos gling pa/ mthong smon pa/ snang rig pa/ lha sdings pa/ sde phug pa/ tshar gung pa/ ka tshal ba/ chos lung pa/ chos sdings pa/ chos 'khor sgang ba/ skar khug pa rnams so/ /des na ngam rim 'di dpal ldan sa skya'i ma dgon du snang ngo*/ /mang mkhar dga' ldan dar rgyas gling*/ dga' ldan chos 'khor/ chu lung*/ chos sdings/ ldog mkhar chung*/ gsang sngags mkhar/ ze mkhar/ dpal ldings/ bsam gtan gling*/ glang sna sbug bong shod/ lha chos 'khor/ 'dod rgyas/ shrī byang ngos/ pha drug gram mtsho/ man dur/ gting skyes/ dang rtsa/ spor thogachos 'khor sde chen la sogs pa ste de dag ni gtsang phyogs kyi chos sde ste/ 'ga' zhig ma gtogs rje'i bstan pas khyab bo/ /stod mnga' ris skor gsum du rje'i bstan pa dar ba'i tshul dang*/ dgon gyi grangs dang*/ bla rabs rnams rgyas par bshad du mi lang bas thar thor zhig brjod na/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi dus su jo bo rje thog mar mnga' ris su byon nas chos mang du gsungs shing*/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis mtho lding dgon btab/ rgyud sde bzhi so sor bzhugs pa'i lha khang*/ bre ldan/ bkra shis bde rgyas/ bkra shis lhun po/ mu dkar chos rdzong*/ rta so chos sde/ la go spel/

ram lam/ o ra ma ṇi dang*/ dung dkar du bkra shis chos gling*/ dga' ldan lhun po/ shangs rtser/ byams pa gling*/ chu bo si tar khri se chos sde/ dpe thub/ klu dkyil/ byams pa gling*/ phu ta/ mar pa gling*/ lhun grub dge 'phel/ rtsa hrang rang rig bkra shis dge 'phel sogs dgon sde che chung shin tu mang yang*/ mdor na mnga' ris phyogs rnams dang*/ kong yul/ spom sbo ra'i yul/ rgya rong gi phyogs rnams su dgon sde che phra brjod kyis mi lang ba lta bu byung ste/ de thams cad du'ang rje'i ring lugs kyis ma khyab pa med do/ / de bzhin du mdo smad khams su yang sku 'bum/ stong 'khor/ sgo mang*/ dgon lung*/ sha rdzong*/ bya khyung dang*/ de dag gi phyogs phyogs na dgon phran shin tu mang la/ gzhan yang byams pa 'bum gling*/ mdzo mo sgar/ thang ring*/ stag lung*/ bkra shis 'khyil/ kha gya/ mdzod dge stod smad sogs na'ang ri khrod kyi dgon du ma yod cing*/ co ne'i phyogs 'dir ni gtso bo tso ne'i ma dgon bshad sgrub gling ngam/ gong ma chen po'i lung gis ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling*/ de'i bu dgon ni gong so/ nags mdo/ glu chung dgon dang*/ gzhan g.yer ba/ 'khyar dge tsha rdor/ mched pa/ smra nyung dgon la sogs pa dgon sde che chung mang du mchis so/ /de dag gi nang nas gtso bo co ne dgon 'di nyin 'debs dus dang bla rabs rnams gang yin cung zad brjod par bya ste/ dgon sde 'di nyid thog mar 'debs mkhan ni co ne'i dpon brgyud du 'khrungs pa chos rje rin chen lhun po zhes grags pa de nyid yin la/ dus gang gi tshe btab pa ni lo 'di la'o zhes nges pa can du 'dzin dka' bar 'dug na yang*/ khong dbus su byon pa'i tshe khri rin po che ye shes bzang po dang mjal nas chos gsan pa'i lo rgyus snang ba ltar na 'di ltar du mngon te/ ye shes bzang po ni 'jam dbyangs gtsang ba gdung bdun rdzogs pa'i rjes su byon cing*/

de yang blo bzang nyi ma dang*/ de'i rjes su chos rje ye shes bzang po khri thog tu phebs par bshad pas/ rje gshegs nas ye shes bzang po'i bar rags rtsis su lo brgyad cu'i skor song bar mngon la/ rin chen lhun po dbus nas byon te dgon 'di btab par 'dod dgos pas rab byung brgyad pa'i smad tsam nas bskrun par sems so/ /rin chen lhun po nas gdan sa'i mkhan po drung pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ drung dben pa blo gros rab gsal/ bsod nams legs pa/ grags pa rin chen/ ngag dbang chos grags/ blo gros grags pa/ dpal ldan bzang po/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams lhun po/ rin chen mchog rgyal/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ tshe brtan don grub/ nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ byin pa dar rgyas/ thugs rje lhun grub/ brtson 'grus dpal ldan/ lha dbang rgya mtsho/ chos skyong rnam rgyal/ blo bzang rgya mtsho/ tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ byams pa bkra shis/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang dar rgyas/ dge 'dun grags pa/ blo bzang tshul khrims/ ngag dbang smon lam/ ngag dbang bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ rin chen blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ grags pa bshad sgrub/ ngag dbang dge legs/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang nyi ma ste/ de rnams kyi nang nas blo bzang tshul khrims/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ grags pa bshad sgrub gsum gyi khri lan gnyis re mdzad cing*/ de ltar na rin chen lhun po nas bgrang bas bla rabs bzhi bcu'o/ /dgon 'dir mtshan nyid grwa tshang byung tshul ni/ dpon gyi gdung brgyud du 'khrungs pa ko'u shrī nang so ngag dbang ba phrin las rgya mtsho pho brang du phebs te rgyal por mjal nas lung tham ka gnang ba'i dus su/ rgyal po nyid dang phyogs de'i bla chen 'gas kyang khyod kyis co ne'i phyogs der mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa zhig tshugs zhes bka' babs pa na zhal gyi bzhes te/ phyir byon nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta'i lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun thub dbang sku bltams pa'i dus chen la kho bo bla mar bskos te mtshan nyid gsar du btsugs/

de nas ko'u shrī sku mched gnyis kyis grwa khang gsar rgyag mdzad pa na kho bo dang ko'u shrī gnyis mthun gros mang du byas te grwa khang gsar 'debs dang chos phyogs nas phan legs po btags kyang drin mi bzo ba 'ga' zhig gis ma shes par snang*/ kho bos grwa tshang khri lo brgyad byas pa'i thog nas gzim khang khri bar bskos te khri gnyis 'dzin byas/ de'i rjes su grags pa rgya mtshos kyang khri gnyis 'dzin mdzad/ de nas slar yang kho bos khri gnyis 'dzin byas te lo gsum tsam song ba na/ ko'u shri yes nas rgyud pa grwa tshang gsar btsugs kyi thog ma'i slo dpon du bskos nas re zhig khri gsum 'dzin byas shing*/ de nas a 'bum tshang rab 'byams pa sgos su grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan par bskos/ de'i rjes su gru rtsi nang rab 'byams pa/ de nas thang nag dka' bcu/ de nas khya'o lung dka' bcu'o/ /rgyud pa'i bla rabs kyi thog ma ni kho bos khri gnyis 'dzin byas te lo kha shas song ba'i tshe sde pa'i nang ngag dbang dge legs bskos kyang lo gcig tsam nas sku gshegs/ slar kho bos khri zur thog gnas lo gsum bzhi tsam rgyud pa'i bla ma byas/ de nas gur chen ngag dbang nyi mas mkhan sa dang rgyud pa'i khri zung 'brel mdzad cing*/ de nas mar thang dka' bcu sgos su rgyud pa'i khri bar bskos so/ /dgon 'di'i grwa pa spyi'i grangs ni mchod ring lta bu'i dus su stong phrag gnyis dang bzhi brgya lnga brgya'i skor tshogs pa 'byung zhing gzhan ni nges pa med do/ /spyir grwa tshang gnyis byung tshul de ltar yin kyang rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa rta nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du ni/ dpon gyi gdung brgyud gong ma chen po'i lung tha ma ka dang bcas pa gnang ste ko'u shri zhes mtshan gsol zhing mdo sngags tha snyad kyi gzhung rab 'byams la mkhas pa'i phul byung mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhal snga nas kyis/

grwa tshang zung 'brel gyi bdag po dang zhabs tog mdzad nas 'chad nyan dang 'don cha sgrigs lam skor gong 'phel du mdzad cing*/ da dung yang mdzad par 'gyur ba ltar lags/ gzhan yang smad rgya sog gi yul du rje'i bstan pa dar te dgon sde 'ga' zhig kyang byung zhing*/ rje'i bstan pa spel ba'i bla chen grags che ba rje btsun dam pa sku snga phyi gnyis/ cang gyā zhabs drung rin po che/ dza ya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bka' 'gyur ba no mo hang*/ bhi yig thu no mo hang sogs du ma ste/ 'dis rgyud thog mar 'dzug pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrubs shing*/ da lta ni cang gyā zhabs kyi sprul sku dang*/ gser khri rin po che'i sprul sku rnam pa gnyis kyi lugs zung gi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang*/ rje'i bstan pa nyid dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do zhes thos shing*/ khyad par du cang gyā zhabs drung rin po che sku sngon mas ni gsung rtsom gyi sgo nas phan 'dogs chen po mdzad snang ngo*/ der ma zad/ da lta ni byang phyogs os lod kyi yul du rje'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur pas da lta'i dus su sangs rgyas dngos byon kyang 'phrin las de'i lhag mdzad rgyu med pa ltar snang ste de thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' drin kyang yin no/ spyir thub pa'i bstan pa ni phyogs kun tu 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i sprul bas gtso bor bzung zhing*/ 'phags yul u rgyan gyi yul dang*/ dzam+bha la ni phyag rdor gyi sprul ba dang*/ bod dang rgya sog gi yul rnams su ni spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa du mas bzung la/ khyad par du khong rnam gnyis kyi sprul ba rje yab sras dang*/ paṇa chen dang*/ rgyal dbang sku snga phyi rnams kyis bzung zhing 'dzin par rtogs so/ /bod kyi rgyal po'i dbang du byas na chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ /khri srong sde btsan/ khri ral sogs kyis bstan pa bzung zhing*/

phyi ma sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang*/ da lta mi dbang zhes grags pa 'dis bstan pa spyi dang*/ rje rin po che'i bstan pa lhag par rgyas par mdzad ces grags so/ /e ma/ thub bstan rnam dag bya lam yangs pa'i mkhar/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i nyin byed shar ba'i tshe/ /mkhas dbang 'od dkar can dang lhan cig tu/ /rje 'brang rgyu skar tshogs kyis kun tu khyab/ /de dag kun gyi ming tsam gsal brjod kyang*/ /gzhung mang nyid du 'gyur na so so yi/ /rnam thar chos 'byung rgyas par brjod byas tshe/ /po ti chen por gyur ba lta ci smos/ /des na de ltar brjod la sgyid lug kyang*/ /rang bstan gtso bo ser 'bras dga' ldan sogs/ /dbus gtsang phyogs kyi dgon ming bla rabs 'ga'/ /dad pas 'phros don cung zad bcas te bkod/ /de las thob pa'i dge legs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /dus gsum rnam dkar klung dang lhan cig tu/ /gnas skabs mngon mtho'i zhing sar smin pa dang*/ /mthar thug kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /ces ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po bstan 'dzin bla rabs dang bcas pa byung tshul chos 'byung gsal bar ston pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gzhung lugs mang du thos par rlom pa shākya'i btsun pa grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas rang lo bcu phrag bdun pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mjug shing byi'i lo'i snon gyi zla bar co ne'i dgon nyid du dad pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ/ maṅgalaṃ/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ ri bo dge ldan pa'i chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs/ - PAGE 26-- PAGE 27-- PAGE 1-
